newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil pension funds post handsome H1 gains - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil pension funds post handsome H1 gains - paper.

text.p: Brazilian pension funds posted impressive first half profits of $5.1 billion, surpassing goals for the entire year, Gazeta Mercantil reported.

The total amount of money invested in Brazilian pension funds at the end of the first half was $65.6 billion, up from $59 billion at the beginning of the year, the paper said. Most of the gain, $5.1 billion, was profit with just $1.5 billion of the increase coming from new contributions.
The gain represented an annualized return on investment of 18 percent.

Stocks accounted for the largest share of funds' investment, representing 31.2 percent of the total in the first half. Mutual funds followed with 14.8 percent and real-estate was third with 13.7 percent, the paper said.
